question: What joint particle-hole, sheet, charge, state and time action follows from the actual retained quarter source, and can its marking be derived covariantly?
summary_de: Die wirkliche Teilchen-Loch-Wirkung bestimmt O=-MRM^T und transportiert Vierteldomäne, Ladung, Zustand, Zeit und die gegebene Markierung. Die zweite Markierung folgt ohne neue Wahl; die erste Quelle und ihre E8-Erweiterung sind nicht aus P1/P2 hergeleitet. Ein Skalarpaarungs-Typfehler wird korrigiert.
summary_en: Actual particle-hole action determines O=-MRM^T and transports quarter domain, charge, state, time and the supplied marking. The second marking needs no new choice; the first source and its E8 extension are not derived from P1/P2. A scalar-pairing type error is corrected.
scope: Actual given chiral source and its exact fold; E8 current lift conditional on the existing extension and coordinate dictionary; original P2 representation audit.
assumptions: The previously supplied chiral source with quarter domains and sea covariance.
The recorded eight-arc fold and exact E8 dictionary M.
For the vertex/current lift only, the stipulated E8 level-one lattice representation and its full cocycle.
The first D5+A3 marking and its Z4 character are supplied, not newly selected.
positive_results: Actual mode conjugation forces branch reversal and O=-MRM^T.
One field lift gives the correct normal-ordered charge and positive-time signs.
The opposite marking follows covariantly from the same source transport and neutral-root moment.
Cocycle-aware E8 current lift preserves vacuum and transports K_alpha to K_(1-alpha) in the stipulated extension.
Full Spin(10) equivariance of the existing antiunitary carrier conjugation.
rules_out: Sheet-oddness as a general necessary criterion for an invariant Hermitian scalar pairing.
Any time-stabilizing orthogonal repair of the fixed D5+A3 marking after this actual quarter conjugation.
Replacing the c=8 vector-fermion source by 16 complex spinor coefficient species without changing the theory.
not_derived: Initial physical marking, original source kernel or E8 extension from P1/P2.
Identification of the linear geometric deck with the antiunitary carrier conjugation.
Full physical event law or T1-T8 completion.
